title: Irreducibility for Covering Data
body_html:
Irreducibility for Covering Data

For any covering datum \(\widetilde\Sigma\), the representation \[ \widetilde\pi_{\widetilde\Sigma} \] is irreducible and supercuspidal.
proof_html: Let \(I(\eta_\Sigma)\) be the ordinary intertwining set for \(\eta_\Sigma\). Yu's intertwining theorem gives \(I(\eta_\Sigma)=K\). For the covering group, the adjoint action factors through \(G\), and the splitting identifies \[ \widetilde K\cap \widetilde g\,\widetilde K\,\widetilde g^{-1} \] with \((K\cap gKg^{-1})\times\mathbb C^\times\). Under this identification, the genuine representation is the ordinary representation tensored with the identity character of \(\mathbb C^\times\). Hence the covering intertwining set is \(\widetilde K\). Compact induction from \(\widetilde K\) is therefore irreducible and supercuspidal by the same criterion as in Yu's proof.
